events.sql:
SELECT 
    T1.vendregistry AS vendor_registry_ID,
    T2.sizecluster AS market_size_cluster,
    T1.vendrate AS Vendor_Trust_Index,
    T1.vendtxcount AS VNC_score
FROM 
    vendors AS T1
JOIN 
    markets AS T2 ON T1.mktref = T2.mktregistry
ORDER BY 
    vendor_registry_ID DESC;
